pointsOfInterest.name: The Keeper Sanctum (Ruined)
pointsOfInterest.description: The ancient Keeper Sanctum, now in ruins after the Iron Dominion's purge. Still holds secrets and artifacts for those brave enough to explore.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Concord Assembly Building
pointsOfInterest.description: The seat of the Concord government. A place of political intrigue, corruption, and power.

pointsOfInterest.name: Underworld Sector U-Scru
pointsOfInterest.description: The dangerous lower levels of Centralis. A lawless zone where information brokers, criminals, and outcasts operate.

pointsOfInterest.name: Central Spire
pointsOfInterest.description: The main city district of Centralis, home to the wealthy and powerful. A stark contrast to the underworld below.
